decisions.choice: Commerce mounts trusted tenant-scoped guest checkout and guest-safe status for Template Store. Server-issued capability is minted by a prepare/bootstrap handshake under durable CAS with no attempt, reservation, or provider call; start is capability-required. Guessed browser IDs, query tokens, and header flags are not authority. Re-read Commerce price/sellability, retain one checkout/order writer and immutable Payments binding, reconcile only against authoritative provider lookup. Browser price, provider, redirect, paid state, success URL or webhook body is not authority. Unmanaged baskets require no Inventory; managed baskets remain fail-closed. Keep USD/card and the accepted checkout-payment-window-004 hosted-card window (paymentWindow:{minSeconds:1800,maxSeconds:1860}); frozen paymentWindowSeconds:1800 originals stay exact. Trusted canonical HTTP(S) site origin must be present and valid for mint and authorize; constructor siteUrl may fill empty runtime ctx.site.url and cannot mask a present public, malformed, or conflicting runtime URL. Public native and Registry write routes admit same-origin requests from request.url plus declared Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site headers and fail closed otherwise. Unexpected failures are guest-safe UNAVAILABLE. Missing runtime/provider support is explicit unavailability, no fake success. Contact/delivery/shipping/tax/promotion semantics are separate unresolved follow-ups.

decisions.choice: Implement only a reusable trusted-owner reservation core under src/features/coupons. Coupon stable identity owns a global cap across immutable rule versions. Reservations persist before any payable session, keyed by immutable original checkout attempt identity and carrying coupon/rule/quote identity; duplicate reserve is idempotent, conflicting reuse fails closed. CAS coordinates concurrent processes and prevents last-slot oversubscription; pending and consumed count toward capacity. Verified success consumes once; confirmed failure/cancel/not-created releases only after authoritative provider reconciliation; unknown outcome never releases based on elapsed time. Terminal attempts stay fenced; release cannot re-reserve a frozen attempt; duplicate/stale/contradictory events cannot double transition; provider session id may attach once immutably. Refund never restores consumed capacity. Expose only trusted-owner ports, with no browser route accepting cap/outcome/amount. Cap is an internal trusted rule/owner snapshot; no production host mount claim. Public handoff context: https://github.com/dinkuskit/coupons/blob/3b6e3fc20ee6d8af61df50f662058e6dfcd0bbda/docs/basic-v1-handoff.md

Reservations persist before any payable session, keyed by immutable original checkout attempt identity and carrying coupon/rule/quote identity; duplicate reserve is idempotent, conflicting reuse fails closed. CAS coordinates concurrent processes and prevents last-slot oversubscription; pending and consumed count toward capacity. Verified success consumes once; confirmed failure/cancel/not-created releases only after authoritative provider reconciliation; unknown outcome never releases based on elapsed time. Terminal attempts stay fenced; release cannot re-reserve a frozen attempt; duplicate/stale/contradictory events cannot double transition; provider session id may attach once immutably. Refund never restores consumed capacity. Expose only trusted-owner ports, with no browser route accepting cap/outcome/amount. Cap is an internal trusted rule/owner snapshot; no production host mount claim.
